scope: Minimal declaration subsets, not complete system headers or an SDK. No upstream implementation code.

c.adaptations: Keep the eight int8_t..int64_t/uint8_t..uint64_t aliases and typedef struct _IO_FILE FILE; resolve scalar spellings to native int1/int2/int4/int8 and uint1/uint2/uint4/uint8. Omit even musl's placeholder struct definition. FILE is incomplete; no libc layout is claimed. stddef.h relies on the native library's existing target-sized size_t builtin; do not redefine it. No int_least/int_fast/intmax aliases, macros or runtime function declarations are supplied.

posix-linux.adaptations: Retain only sa_family_t and sockaddr; resolve unsigned short to native uint2. This explicitly selected profile asserts the Linux socket ABI (2-byte family, 14-byte data, 16-byte total); never infer Linux from ELF/default compiler. Not Darwin/BSD.

win32.license: ZPL-2.1 (unmarked headers); public-domain CRT type substitutions
win32.adaptations: Modified 2026-10-17. Keep HANDLE, DWORD, BOOL, WCHAR, LONG, LONGLONG, LARGE_INTEGER only. Resolve __LONG32/int/wchar_t/__int64 to native uint4/int4/uint2/int8; preserve signed QuadPart and signed HighPart. Retain named u low/high overlay, omit duplicate anonymous overlay and pointer aliases. Remove macros, attributes, conditional compilation and includes. Requires Windows platform and windows/clangwindows compiler, int=4, long=4, pointer=4 or 8; no host wchar_t/long assumptions.
